newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EMV EYES MAIN LIST DURING Q2.
newsitem.headline: EMV EYES MAIN LIST DURING Q2.

text.p: Shareholders of construction firm EMV approved a plan to list its shares on the Tallinn stock exchange main list and the company said on Monday it hoped to reach the list during the second quarter of this year.
The board authorised stockbroker Aktoris, recently bought by Handelsbanken, to organise the move to the official list.
"We hope to be listed on the main list during the second quarter," Vilve Kalda, public relations head, told Reuters.
EMV shares are currently traded on the over-the-counter free market of the stock exchange.
